cells.gaps: No source found says the local storage requirement has gone, or that the Authority has published a list of adequate countries, model terms or a general authorisation.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The 2024 Proclamation sets conditions on transfers, including adequacy and consent [ETH-002]. Several sources say it also requires locally collected personal data to be stored in Ethiopia, a general localisation rule [ETH-004][ETH-005]. Question 2 is closed and the stage is 2.
